overview: The Medford High School Advisory Teams for Sustainability/MEP and Exterior/Interior Design held their initial listening sessions to outline their respective processes. Members identified priority goals regarding environmental standards, local grid infrastructure, durable aesthetics, and civic integration for the high school project.

items.title: Sustainability / MEP Team Introductions & Schedule Overview
items.summary: The advisory team introduced members and outlined the four-meeting process to establish mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and sustainability recommendations for the building committee.

items.title: Sustainability Givens & Regulatory Baselines
items.summary: Sustainable Design Director Martine Dion reviewed baseline green building requirements, highlighting LEED Silver certification, compliance with the Massachusetts Specialized Stretch Code, and an all-electric HVAC target.

items.title: Sustainability & MEP Priority Goals Discussion
items.summary: The team conducted a listening session where members shared priority goals, including net-zero emissions, embodied carbon reduction, electric school bus charging infrastructure, commissioning processes, and local grid capacity.

items.title: Exterior & Interior Design Team Introductions & Project Overview
items.summary: Design team members introduced themselves and discussed the advisory group's role in gathering diverse stakeholder feedback on aesthetics, materials, and space planning.

items.title: Exterior & Interior Design Priority Goals Discussion
items.summary: The committee held a design listening session focusing on durable and non-trendy materials, sightlines, visual arts integration, community accessibility, local history representation, and flexible spaces.
